'''Laandon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Laandon was stationed in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he was [[Death|killed]] when the Empire's warehouses there were raided by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operatives.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Laandon appears as a enemy on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
